reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The high-scale mode for ipcache has been deprecated and will be removed in v1.18", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: The high-scale mode for ipcache will be removed in v1.18; environments using this mode should stop using it before upgrading.

proposed.statement: The high-scale mode for ipcache has been deprecated in v1.17.0 and will be removed in v1.18.
